description:
The number puzzle that eats afternoons. Swipe to slide every tile on the board at once; when two matching tiles touch, they merge into one. Keep doubling until you reach the legendary 2048 tile — then see how far past it you can go.

This edition is built to feel great: buttery tile slides, a satisfying pop on every merge, soft sound design and haptics that make big combos land. Made a mistake? Take back your last move with Undo. Your board is saved automatically, so you can pick up right where you left off.

Play with swipes, a mouse drag, or the arrow keys. No ads, no timers, no nonsense — just you and the tiles.
whatsNew: New midnight theme with glowing high-value tiles, one-step Undo, and automatic board saving. Keep going after 2048 to chase 4096 and beyond.
